changes.facility_name: Central Utility Plant at White Oak
changes.old_value: not included in this inventory; Form EIA-860 does not report air-permit decisions
changes.new_value: The facility has been subject to Maryland Department of the Environment air permitting. An initial Significant Permit to Operate (SPTO) for fuel burning equipment was applied for in 2015-2016 (permit number 2015 031-2552) for the address 10903 New Hampshire Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20903. A Title V (Part 70) operating permit was also under development for the GSA Federal Research Center at White Oak as of a public review docket. Current permit status (active, expired, or renewed) not confirmed in reviewed sources as of 2026-08-16.

judge.reason: The first excerpt directly supports the SPTO application claim: it shows 'fda federal research center at white oak 10903 new hampshire ave silver spring md 20903 application received for 2015 031 2552' and 'initial spto for cup' (Central Utility Plant). The second excerpt supports the Title V (Part 70) operating permit docket existence with permit number 24-031-1129 for 'gsa federal research center at white oak' at '10901 10903 new hampshire avenue silver spring md 20903' — note the address is 10901-10903, not exactly 10903, but this is the same facility. The claim's final clause about current permit status not being confirmed is self-acknowledged and thus not requiring source support. However, the claim states permit number 2015 031-2552 was 'applied for in 2015-2016' while the source shows 'application received' in February 2016 — the year range 2015-2016 is slightly broader than the source confirms (the permit number starts with 2015, suggesting 2015 filing, but the source only confirms February 2016 receipt). The address 10903 New Hampshire Ave is directly in the first excerpt. The claim that 'current permit status not confirmed in reviewed sources as of 2026-08-16' is accurate as the sources are from 2016 and 2021 (draft). The minor address discrepancy (10903 vs 10901-10903) and the 2015-2016 date range vs. confirmed February 2016 receipt are slight imprecisions but the core claims are directly supported.
